name: anim_jyu_riseC
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: The head slowly lowers from looking up to looking straight ahead, the gaping mouth closes into the grumpy closed mouth with the sticky strings snapping and dripping, and the eyes open. At the same time the melting paint body firms up, the drips slow down, the legs pull up out of the puddle into straight human legs with bare feet, and he crosses his thick arms over his chest. The head, ears, hair and face keep the same design the whole time. Slow, sticky, viscous. It ends exactly in the pose of the last frame.
